positions.statement: In his pamphlet statement, Straus describes homelessness, addiction, mental illness and unaffordable housing as one system rather than separate problems needing separate budgets.

positions.statement: Straus says in his pamphlet statement that the state's minimum wage and licensing of informal work price the least-skilled out of legal work.
positions.excerpt: The state prices the least-skilled out of legal work with a minimum wage, licenses every informal alternative out of existence

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 51

positions.statement: On his platform page, Straus says he opposes all tax increases and would abolish the property tax and repeal the income tax.
positions.excerpt: Abolish the property tax, repeal the income tax.

positions.statement: His platform page says he supports educational freedom, including repealing compulsory attendance laws.
positions.excerpt: Support full educational freedom: repeal compulsory attendance laws

positions.statement: His platform page opposes permit requirements for firearms.
positions.excerpt: No permission slip for a right.

positions.statement: His platform page calls for ending state provision and compulsory financing of medical care.
positions.excerpt: End state provision and compulsory financing of medical care,

positions.statement: His platform page says TriMet should be privatized or dissolved.
positions.excerpt: TriMet should be privatized or dissolved.

positions.statement: His platform page says polluters should be sued rather than licensed, as a replacement for permits.
positions.excerpt: Sue the polluter, don’t license him.

positions.statement: His platform page says Oregon should maintain and strengthen its sanctuary status.
positions.excerpt: Maintain and strengthen Oregon’s sanctuary status:
